# Simulated accuracy

**Simulated, not measured.** Generated by `npm run bench` (scripts/bench.ts) on 2026-09-30.
Re-run it whenever a venue, a tour, the radio model or the engine changes.

Radio model from docs/SPEC.md (log-distance n = 2.2, RSSI@1m = −59 dBm, Gaussian noise σ, 10% packet drop,
18 dB per floor slab, 3 dB through an atrium void). One scan every 250 ms. Each number is the mean over seeds 1, 2, 3.
Horizontal error is counted only on fixes that picked the right floor; the floor column covers the rest.

The simulator has no walls, furniture, people or multipath, so real-world error will be larger.
Treat these as a comparison between methods, not as a promise of field accuracy.

# New Computer Science Building

Setup: 55 beacons on 3 floors (src/data/ncs.json). Traced from the official floor plans (Mitchell | Giurgola Architects, 2015) published at stonybrook.edu/commcms/csbuilding. See docs/FLOORPLAN_TRACING.md.
